svg.text: An assembly line that builds AI’s location-by-location carbon & water “bill,” checks it against regulation — and (Ceiling) projects it forward to test policy.
FLOOR — guaranteed by 31 Dec, pure arithmetic on sourced numbers, no forecasting
CEILING — ambitious add-ons, each behind a gate
S9 · UNCERTAINTY — Monte-Carlo ± ranges wrap every stage (today & projected). No phantom precision.
coupled carbon + water, US · EU · India
where high burden meets no rule

Reading order: inputs → S0 join → S1 energy → S2–S5 carbon/water/scarcity/basin → S6 maps → S10 policy-gap. Ceiling: S6 baseline + forecasts → S11 → S7 levers → S8 equity. S9 wraps all with uncertainty.
